# Saad Mazhar

> Full-stack developer and startup founder based in Colombo, Sri Lanka, building AI-powered products and web apps.

This is the personal site of Saad Mazhar. Content below is organized by section; each link is the canonical URL for that section.

## Key facts

- Saad Mazhar is a startup founder and full-stack developer from Colombo, Sri Lanka.
- He is building TankSudda (https://tanksudda.com) and is co-founder of Stopwash (PVT) Ltd. (https://stopwash.lk).
- He works as a Business Development Associate at Spectrify AI (since October 2025).
- He is studying for a BSc (Hons) in Computer Science at the University of Westminster (since September 2023), after a Foundation Certificate at the Informatics Institute of Technology (IIT).
- He is a debater, host and compere, and was Captain of the English Debate Team at Isipathana College, Colombo.
- Profiles: https://www.linkedin.com/in/saadmaz/ · https://github.com/saadmaz · https://x.com/SaadMazhar_
